pinned_model_source.name: PyWake
use: Bastankhah Gaussian and IEA-37 simplified Bastankhah equations
IEA-37 wind rose, 3.35 MW turbine, circular layouts and boundaries

horns_rev.turbine: Vestas V80 2 MW, D=80 m, hub height=70 m
horns_rev.wake: Bastankhah Gaussian k=0.0324555, ceps=0.2, source CT evaluated at propagated effective speed while deficit amplitude uses ambient reference speed, squared deficit superposition
horns_rev.wind: 360 one-degree directions by 23 integer speed bins from 3 through 25 m/s
horns_rev.boundary: paper-linked Hornsrev1_xl parallelogram with one lattice-distance padding
horns_rev.purpose: time per iteration, exact/FD/CS gradient comparison, flow-case parallelization and spacing-constraint cost

iea37.turbine: IEA-37 3.35 MW, D=130 m, constant CT=8/9
iea37.wake: IEA-37 simplified Bastankhah Gaussian, k=0.0324555, D/sqrt(8) initial width, squared deficit superposition
iea37.wind: 9.8 m/s and the 16-bin IEA-37 rose resampled to 360 one-degree directions by PyWake nearest-sector semantics
iea37.purpose: iteration scaling, random multi-start and SMAST initialization/optimization

paper_native_method.design_variables: continuous x and y coordinate of every turbine
paper_native_method.optimization_constraints: farm boundary only; two-diameter spacing is enforced during initialization and omitted during optimization

smast.semantics: sequentially place a turbine among the top 100-random_percent percentile candidate cells according to its own AEP under wakes from already placed turbines; ignore reverse wake impact on prior turbines

paper_protocol.role_derivation: 35 unique Horns configurations after deduplicating repeated AD-one-core/no-spacing roles; 27 Storyline3 IEA size/randomness roles; 3 distinct 10000-start pure-random benchmark roles
paper_protocol.platform_role_derivation: 25 Horns source-oracle and highest-performance exact-gradient/finite-difference roles plus 30 stochastic IEA roles
paper_protocol.registered_observation_only_roles: five complex-step and five pair-spacing-cost diagnostic roles are retained as paper observations because they are comparator/diagnostic experiments rather than the proposed production method
paper_protocol.paper_random_optimization_counts: 1000 runs per IEA size/randomness setting where present; two 5000-run batches for N=16,64,279 at random_percent=100
paper_protocol.formal_budget_note: the platform 25-seed campaign is an independent flexible-reproduction campaign; the immutable public 55,000-plus run arrays remain separate author evidence

missing_information: complete author environment lock and exact TOPFARM revision
complete launch scripts for every paper panel and Horns Rev timing arrays
SLSQP internal trajectory, final coordinate arrays and random bitstreams
exact CPU affinity, cluster scheduler state and memory measurement method for every timing point
paper-specific finite-difference and complex-step step sizes
conflicts_and_completions: Use PyWake v2.5.0 physical CT=8/9 plus D/sqrt(8) simplified wake width; record the paper's approximately 0.964 equivalence statement as a textual parameterization conflict rather than changing turbine CT.
Implement the source-equivalent chain rule as fixed reverse accumulation in pure C++; validate it against bound-independent central finite differences.
Use NLopt v2.11.0 Kraft SLSQP revision 88c424d4f458412787df96fcc95218acbca224fd because the public archive does not pin SciPy/TOPFARM internals.

Treat the 5000 value stored in both public NetCDF tensors as a SciPy iteration setting, not an NLopt evaluation count; the production reconstruction separately caps NLopt at 5000 objective callbacks and reports all callback and physical-layout counts.
Use 0.05 m as the central finite-difference completion because the paper and public helper do not publish the step; this comparator is never used as the production optimizer gradient.
Treat complex-step as a non-target published comparator observation and do not fabricate a complex-valued C++ wake implementation.
Use counter-keyed random choices and declare random-stream differences; never calibrate seeds to published AEP.
Retain the published 10,000/5,000-start arrays as external validation evidence; formal platform runs start from scratch and carry their own receipts.
Use 25 platform seeds for the formal campaign while retaining paper-native run counts in the protocol metadata.

pinned_source_oracles.generator: PyWake v2.5.0 at the pinned revision with public source layouts and default PropagateDownwind semantics

hpc.prior_parallel_boundary: The paper explicitly evaluates flow-case parallelization on 1,4,16,32 CPUs and recommends top-level multi-start parallelization. The reproduction does not claim first parallelization.

analysis.finite_difference_work: 2*(2*Nturbine)+1 complete evaluator traversals for a central gradient
analysis.exact_gradient_work: one forward wake-order traversal plus one reverse traversal computes AEP and all 2*Nturbine derivatives, including the effective-speed-to-CT-to-downstream-wake path
analysis.naive_smast_work: O(Ncandidate*Ndirection*Nturbine^2) if every partial layout is recomputed
analysis.implemented_smast_work: O(Ncandidate*Ndirection*Nturbine) incremental source updates plus fixed-order reductions
analysis.outer_parallelism: independent starts use process-level scheduling; inner flow workers are set to one under outer saturation

strategy: one persistent all-core executor per inner optimization
parallel flow-state objective and exact-gradient computation
speed-independent coordinate rotation reused inside each flow state
fixed-index state outputs followed by deterministic ordered reduction
separate outer multi-start scheduling to prevent nested oversubscription
hpc.required_invariant: one-worker and all-worker AEP, exact gradient and scientific hash identity

claim_boundary: Source-backed flexible academic reproduction of both paper problem families, SMAST, exact-gradient SLSQP, flow-case and multi-start parallelization; not author Python/SciPy trajectory, random bitstream, exact numerical/timing replay, complex-step comparator implementation, or first parallelization claim.
